newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Generale de Geophysique started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Generale de Geophysique started.

text.p: Jefferies & Co analyst Sam Albright has initiated coverage of Compagnie Generale de Geophysique with a buy rating.
-- He has a 12 month target price for global seismic company of $24 per ADS. It was trading at 19-1/4.
-- "CGG is now regaining market share in its core markets and experiencing a major turnaround in profitability after several years of weak operating and financial results," Albright said.
-- CCG trades at 5.1 times cash flow per share compared with 7.9 times for its peer group. ((-- New York Newsroom 212 859 1902))
